enchantments.tooltip: +12 Enhancement Bonus: +12 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Returning: This missile will return to you.
Sovereign Vorpal: Passive: +0.5[W] damage dice.On Vorpal Hit: If your target has fewer than 3000 Hit Points, they are instantly slain. If your target has above 3000 Hit Points, they take 300 damage.
Deadly XI: Passive: +11 Competence bonus to Melee and Ranged damage.

Bloodletter VII: On Critical Hit: 15 to 90 Slashing damage from weapons with a x2 Critical Multiplier, 15 to 120 Slashing damage from weapons with a x3 Critical Multiplier, and 15 to 150 Slashing damage from weapons with a x4 or greater Critical Multiplier.
Ranged Power +6: This item provides a +6 Enhancement bonus to Ranged Power.
Flametouched Iron: Flametouched Iron grants +1 saves versus Evil Outsiders.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
